verdict.rationale: Rive is a cloud-based editor with an AI agent, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack covers an opt-out, a data-usage policy, or any commitment that user files are not used to train AI models. The AI agent, MCP, and revision-history items describe adjacent features and do not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
